roles.description:
• Own the weekly service review for a 40-person support org; publish stakeholder-ready status with risks, owners, and dates.

  • Cut average ticket backlog 30% by introducing a triage rota and a same-day escalation path.

  • Led the incident-response rota through two severity-1 outages; wrote the post-incident reviews and tracked corrective actions to closure.

  • Automated the Monday reporting pack (Python + spreadsheets), saving roughly four hours a week.

• Resolved escalated warehouse-system tickets across three distribution centers.

  • Wrote the first runbook for label-printer failures, the team's most frequent incident class.

  • Trained 12 new support hires on the ticketing system and escalation policy.

items.description:
• Front-line support for a clinic scheduling platform used by 300+ practices.

  • Built the macro library the team still uses for the top 50 ticket types.

  • Flagged a recurring sync defect with reproduction steps that let engineering fix it in one sprint.

• Sequenced the cutover of two warehouses to a new WMS over one weekend each, with rollback steps per phase.

  • Both cutovers finished inside their windows with no lost shipments.
items.name: Warehouse migration runbook

items.description:
• Designed the board views and saved filters the support org now uses for daily triage.

  • Added an aging view that surfaces tickets older than five days automatically.
items.name: Support queue triage board

summary.content: Operations lead with eight years across logistics support and service delivery. Known for turning recurring incidents into runbooks, and for status reporting that stakeholders actually read.
